summary: Sadot Group Inc. formed 50/50 joint venture CMJV LLC with VisionWave Holdings to pursue C.M. Composite Materials Ltd., an Israeli advanced-composites manufacturer. Sadot committed $7,814,323 cash and issued 250,000 SDOT shares as an entry premium; VisionWave contributed its loan rights and ~$7.81M advances to CM. CMJV holds rights to acquire 51% of CM, with a call option on the remaining 49%. The long-stop date under VisionWave's Share Purchase Agreement was extended to December 31, 2026, and the Belrise Condition remains unsatisfied. Watch regulatory approvals and financing risk.
